$comment: The theme contract: what every theme package must provide. Read by @ggary/checks. Adding a name or a pair here makes every theme fail until it complies — which is the point.

tokens.--gg-surface: a raised surface: panel, card, popover
tokens.--gg-surface-sunken: a recessed surface: inset, code block, sidebar
tokens.--gg-accent-bg: a tinted background under accent text
tokens.--gg-space-option: between the options of one group, and from a group's label to its first option
tokens.--gg-space-group: between groups and fields stacked in a form: more than inside a group, so a group reads as one
tokens.--gg-z-popover: the stacking level of floating content
tokens.--gg-chart-1: the colour of series 1 in a chart: a mark (3:1), never text. The order is part of the contract
tokens.--gg-chart-2: the colour of series 2 in a chart: a mark (3:1), never text. The order is part of the contract
tokens.--gg-chart-3: the colour of series 3 in a chart: a mark (3:1), never text. The order is part of the contract
tokens.--gg-chart-4: the colour of series 4 in a chart: a mark (3:1), never text. The order is part of the contract
tokens.--gg-chart-5: the colour of series 5 in a chart: a mark (3:1), never text. The order is part of the contract
tokens.--gg-chart-6: the colour of series 6 in a chart: a mark (3:1), never text. The order is part of the contract

runtime.--gg-available-height: written by core's attachPositioner onto a positioner at runtime
runtime.--gg-grid-row-height: the height of every data grid row: a theme sets it on the grid's frame, and core reads it to place rows (or writes it, when the page fixes a height)
runtime.--gg-grid-header-height: written by core onto a data grid's frame: the measured height of its header row
runtime.--gg-split-size: written by core onto a split's frame: the primary pane's size
runtime.--gg-split-rest-min: written by core onto a split's frame: the least the other pane keeps
runtime.--gg-tree-level: set by core on each tree row: its depth, from 1, for the indent
runtime.--gg-progress: set by core on a progress track: how far along, from 0 to 1
runtime.--gg-gantt-days: set by core on a gantt's root: how many days the chart shows
runtime.--gg-gantt-start: set by core on a gantt's bar, scale cell and today line: its first day, counted from the chart's
runtime.--gg-gantt-span: set by core on a gantt's bar and scale cell: how many days it spans
runtime.--gg-gantt-weekend: set by core on a gantt's root: the first Saturday, counted from the chart's first day
runtime.--gg-gantt-x1: set by core on a gantt arrow's segment and head: its first point, in days from the chart's start
runtime.--gg-gantt-x1-gap: set by core with --gg-gantt-x1: how many of the theme's small gaps beside it
runtime.--gg-gantt-x2: set by core on a gantt arrow's segment: its second point, in days
runtime.--gg-gantt-x2-gap: set by core with --gg-gantt-x2: how many of the theme's small gaps beside it
runtime.--gg-gantt-y1: set by core on a gantt arrow's segment and head: its first point, in rows from the first task's top
runtime.--gg-gantt-y2: set by core on a gantt arrow's segment: its second point, in rows
runtime.--gg-flow-self: set by a stack or a section on each child: how a component sized by its content stands in the column (it reads it, with auto outside one)
runtime.--gg-icon: mapped from data-icon by @ggary/icons; a theme never declares it on the root
runtime.--gg-series: the colour a chart component draws a series in; set by an application to override the palette

$pairs: What every theme promises through the public names, whatever its language. Deliberately small: only what the token descriptions above promise, and nothing about how a theme builds depth — GGarry divides same-white surfaces with borders, a theme may as well separate them by lightness, and both are legitimate. min: text 4.5:1, large 3:1, step ΔL 0.022.

pairs.label: contract: accent text on its tint
